args.reason: The first PRD goal states that historical storage and query features are outside this PRD. Two of the three DoD items add exactly that: a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log appended on every evaluation, and a --explain timeline with --since and --format query options. These capabilities are not in the declared goal set, so the DoD exceeds the PRD. Phase 1's claim that this is a natural extension of inspection ignores the explicit exclusion. Only the --dry-run item is warranted.
